estimate.interim_fcf_method: linear path from normalized start FCF to terminal FCF; cash earns zero

inference: The official balance-sheet reconciliation removes the earlier cash/debt anomaly, but the current equity value still needs an aggressive sustained cash-conversion outcome; the extraordinary 2026 Q2 profit step-up prevents labeling that outcome impossible without more cash-flow evidence.
opinion: Assign one of six expectation-gap points and keep the price veto at INVESTIGATE rather than FAIL pending audited cash-flow conversion and cycle-normalized capex.
key_limitation: Q2 figures are preliminary and the model cannot treat a 76% quarterly operating margin as a steady state; normalized FCF is an estimate, not reported guidance.

inference: The valuation does not require an extreme terminal multiple, but a 10% return requires owner earnings to compound near 8% despite current low-single-digit revenue guidance, automotive cyclicality, and captive-finance credit risk.
opinion: Two of six expectation-gap points are warranted: the bull clears the hurdle, the base does not, and price itself is not a Hard Veto.
key_limitation: Consolidated owner earnings preserve captive-finance economics but do not isolate manufacturing FCFE, regulatory capital, guarantees, or class-specific dividend rights.

fact.merck_royalty_description: low-single-digit royalty on net sales after all sales milestones are achieved

bear.description: limited Qlex milestones, late-program attrition, no repeat platform conversion

base.description: material Qlex milestone realization plus one additional approval, but modest royalty scale

bull.description: broad Qlex conversion, at least three additional partner successes, and durable royalty/supply economics

inference: Repeated big-pharma contracts and commercial Qlex sales validate the platform, yet undiscounted headline milestones are not equity value; at the current price the 10% hurdle is reached only in the multi-success bull branch.
opinion: Assign one of six expectation-gap points and keep price at INVESTIGATE. The bull is plausible, but the probability-weighted model offers no margin of safety at the 10% hurdle.
key_limitation: Most royalty rates, milestone timing, product identities and development probabilities are confidential; branch probabilities and terminal values are explicitly subjective ranges, not company guidance.
